steps.content: Hella and Hecate become instantly ensnared. Amidst the chaos, Mess disappears from your sight. When she reappears, she grabs you by the collar and pushes you against the wall.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Caught you for the second time... You really need to work out more.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: What are you going to do to me? Are you going to kill me?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No. I have a surprise for you.

steps.content: You take out the bottle of Ambrosia that Doyle gave you from your coat pocket and smash it to the ground. Blue mist spreads like flames, overwhelming both of you at the same time.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: That smell... Ambrosia?!

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.content: I know the trick you're talking about. It's an effervescent tablet that's quite popular recently. Throw a tablet into the water, seal it and shake it. Once you open it again, it will spray mist. Useful for startling people.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.content: Wait a minute... Why? You're not thinking of making me go buy some, are you?!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ...Cough, you... tricked me?! From the very beginning...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Just a gift in return for what you did a couple days ago.

steps.content: Mess loosens her grip on your neck in panic. She scrambles to cover her mouth and nose, but it's too late.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Ha, you idiot... By doing this... You... can't... run... away... either...
You don't need to run away. You know where you'll be going.
Standing in the blue mist, you watch Mess collapse and close her eyes. Eerie music and distant roars echo in your ears. You recite the rules again:

<color=#fb9259>Shackles are rendered useless</color>, <color=#fb9259>the owner's subconscious creates everything</color>, <color=#fb9259>break the happiness created by Ambrosia to break the dream</color>... You are ready to enter Mess's dream.
All the questions she refuses to answer... All her crazy words that are true and false... You will find the answers to them in this dream that doesn't lie.
This is the subconscious world. Here, she won't lie. But as you think this, the scene that gradually unfolds before you makes you unable to believe your eyes.
A massive shadow obscures your view. It's so grotesque, so incongruous, that it seems to refute everything you know. It doesn't abide by the laws of reason...
Grrr... Grumble... Destroy...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Like... a dragon, a great big dragon... With ears like this, and a long, long tail... Oh, and he breathes fire! Let me see. Does he have three heads or just one...
Is this... the dragon? The monster before you is...

steps.speaker: Roaring Dragon
steps.content: I'll... destroy... you...!!!!
The giant dragon opens his humongous, pixelated bloody mouth, and tries his best to repeat the 32nd performance:

steps.speaker: Roaring Dragon
steps.content: I'll... destroy... you...!!!!
